messages:
leo (PM): Quick async Q2 OKR milestone check-in for Autoscale + Routing.
leo (PM): TL;DR — partial ship today (routing fallbacks + metrics), two slipped items (kv-cache resilience, dedupe pipeline), owners listed below. Please reply with concise status + immediate blockers. No long threads — ping owners for follow-ups.
sam (Product): Thanks — short summary from product side:
- Shipped: canary routing fallback (50% traffic), metrics dashboard updated.
- Slipped: kv-cache resilience tests (flake on multi-GPU), dedupe pipeline perf.
Owners: maria for kv-cache, kevin for dedupe infra.
maria (Eng): kv-cache flake root cause is race on cache invalidation when GPU node restarts. Repro steps in my branch.
maria (Eng): Patch ready but need staging repro infra. Holding on test infra provisioning from kevin.
kevin (Infra): I saw the repro request. I can spin up a two-node staging cluster by EOD but need approval for extra quota. jess do we have room in the staging pool?
jess (SRE): We can carve out 1xA100 for 6h today for a repro run. I'll approve quota if kevin drops the exact instance spec.
kevin (Infra): Spec: a100-40gb x2 + 256GB RAM, ubuntu:22, docker image: redwood/runtime:staging-20260318.
jess (SRE): Approved. I'll tag team on the infra ticket and add the schedule window.
ana (Design): Noted — design review for routing UI changes shipped. One small copy tweak left, will submit a PR to the metrics dashboard this afternoon.
sam (Product): Dedupe pipeline perf: observed 30% slower on large-batch test. kevin, do you think this is infra (IO) or config (batching)?
kevin (Infra): Looks like IO bottleneck on our NFS mount during the batch. Short term: move temp files to local SSD in the job spec. Longer term: move to shared ramdisk or S3-backed chunking.
maria (Eng): I'll try local-SSD change and run a perf sweep. If that helps, we can toggle in config and ship as a patch.
leo (PM): Ownership summary for next steps:
- kv-cache resilience: maria (Eng) — needs repro window from kevin + SRE support from jess. Target: repro + fix in 48h.
- dedupe perf: maria + kevin paired — try local-SSD toggle, measure; target: config patch in 72h.
- metrics copy tweak: ana (Design) — PR by EOD.
- canary routing: sam (Product) — monitor for errors, escalate if >1% error rate.
sam (Product): Monitoring note: linked dashboard -> https://dash.redwood.cloud/d/okrs/autoscale-routing
sam (Product): Current error rate 0.2% on canary, latency P95 up 8ms.
maria (Eng): CR ping: runtime PR 412 needs one more review (esp. invalidation logic). https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412
maria (Eng): @sam can you or @leo confirm release window if tests pass? We prefer quick patch release after repro confirmed.
leo (PM): If kv fix lands and passes staging, aim to roll to canary within ~4h post-merge. Keep me posted here.
kevin (Infra): I'll post staging cluster link and creds to the infra ticket and mark resources ready.
jess (SRE): I'll run the repro during the approved window and stream logs to the ticket. If we see node OOMs, I'll escalate.
sam (Product): Small ask: can we get an owners note in the OKR doc summarizing slips + new ETA? I'll update but need confirm from owners.
maria (Eng): ETA kv-cache fix -> PR by tomorrow 14:00 UTC if repro runs today. Dedupe perf -> config patch by 72h.
kevin (Infra): Confirm infra tasks done once cluster link posted.
ana (Design): PR for copy tweak -> #design-pr-57 (small change), will tag sam for signoff.
leo (PM): Quick blockers checklist:
- quota/cluster: kevin/jess -> approved
- CR review: needs one reviewer -> volunteers?
- Can we avoid a large rollback? plan: small canary increments, rollback window 30m.
sam (Product): I'll take the CR review now. :thumbsup:
maria (Eng): Thanks. I'll rebase and request your review in 10.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled -> staging cluster ready at https://staging.redwood.cloud/cluster/8421 (expires in 6h)
leo (PM): If no objections, owners to post status updates here once tasks hit the target times. We won't schedule a live meeting unless slips >72h or errors >1%.
sam (Product): Acknowledged. Will update OKR doc and ping owners when PRs merge.
maria (Eng): Acknowledged. Will post test results and PR link here.
kevin (Infra): Acknowledged. Will post infra link and confirm resource teardown window.
jess (SRE): Acknowledged. Will run repro and paste logs to ticket.
ana (Design): Acknowledged. Will submit copy PR by EOD.
leo (PM): Thanks everyone. Short async updates only — if you need a quick huddle, drop a note and I'll set 15m. :calendar:
